message:
I found the bug. Look at this line:

```cpp
recordInfo.mDataBufferSize = sizeof(name);
```

This sets `mDataBufferSize` to `sizeof(name)` which is `OT_DNS_MAX_NAME_SIZE` (probably 255), but the `data` buffer is only `kMaxRrDataSize` bytes. Then:

```cpp
OutputBytes(recordInfo.mDataBuffer, recordInfo.mDataBufferSize);
```

This reads `mDataBufferSize` bytes from `data` buffer, which is a stack-buffer-overflow READ if `mDataBufferSize` (255) exceeds `kMaxRrDataSize`.

Let me check the values of these constants.

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>grep -rn "kMaxRrDataSize" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/src/cli/cli_dns.cpp /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/src/cli/cli_dns.hpp && grep -rn "OT_DNS_MAX_NAME_SIZE" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/include/openthread/dns.h | head -5</｜｜DSML｜｜>
